Both an African American man and an African American woman had to wait a long time in line at a government office due to problems. The African American man started yelling after she was able to speak to someone at a desk, but the African American woman just cried out of frustration. Which person yelled when they spoke to someone?
A. Undetermined
B. The African American woman
C. The African American man
